rnal 'byor rgyud la yang de'i steng du slob dpon gyi dbang dgos la/ bla med la ni dbang bzhi rdzogs par dgos so/ /des na 'dir yang slob ma'i dbang dang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang mtha' brtan bcas byed pa skabs su bab la/ slob dpon gyi dbang yang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung sngon du song ba'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yin gyi/ slob dpon gyi dbang tsam zhig ni/ bya spyod gnyis la'ang yod par ṭīka chen du bshad do/ /sbyod rgyud las/ bum pa la sogs ji snyed ming thogs nas/ /bcu bo rnams kyi dbang ni ci dgar bskur/ /zhes pa'i bcu bo rnams zhes pa'i dbang bcu ni/ ṭika chen las/ chu/ cod pan/ 'phreng ba/ dar dbyangs/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ yum lnga'i phyag mtshan/ ming dbang*/ 'phrin las/ 'khor lo bskor ba yan lag bcas/ bdag po'i dbang*/ gsang dbang dang bshad kyang*/ rin chen 'phreng ba dang dar dbyangs gnyis dbu rgyan gyi 'khor yin pas/ de gnyis grangs gcig tu byas na bcur gsungs la/ gzhan du bcu gcig tu yod do/ /des na dbang la gsum/ slob ma'i dbang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang*/ de dag gi mtha' brten no/ /dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor kyi shar sgo'i mdun du 'dug ste/ dbang stegs pad+ma dag zla ba'i gdan la slob ma rdor sems sogs me tog phog pa'i lha gang yin pa der bskyed la/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod sogs kyis mchod nas/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyi shis brjod bya'o/ /las bum ma gtogs bum cu rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdu'o/ /de ltar med kyang rnam rgyal bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzung la/ rdo rje slob dpon ngas khyod la zhes sogs dang tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa'i rgyas pa'am/ rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis sogs tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis gzhung ltar bum dbang dam chu dbang rgyas bsdus ci rigs bskur/ de nas dbu rgyan/ de'i 'khor rin chen 'phreng ba dang dar dpyangs/

rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ yum lnga'i phyag mtshan/ ming dbang bcas sngar ltar ram/ shin tu bsdu na sngags rkyang bas bya'o/ /de thams cad la phyag rgya dang bcas par gzung bzhin dang*/ slob ma lhar gsal gdab pa la sgeg sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar dbang bskur bas nus pa gang 'jog pa ni/ sngar gyi me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang gis/ slob ma de lha gang gi rigs yin par shes pa dang*/ 'dir chu dbang gis sgrib pa'i dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa 'jog /de bzhin du/ dbu rgyan gyis sangs rgyas pa na de'i rigs bdag dang*/ gtsug tor 'grub pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi sangs rgyas de'i ye shes lnga 'grub pa dang*/ yum lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis sangs rgyas de'i gsung 'grub pa dang*/ ming dbang gis sangs rgyas de'i mtshan nges can du 'grub pa'i nus pa 'jog go / gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du khrus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes sogs mtshan nyid tshang ba'i khrus dkyil gyi steng du slob ma rdor sems su bskyed de nyer spyod sogs kyis mchod la shis brjod bya/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi gtso bo dam tshig gsum sbyin par bya ste/ thog tha med pa'i sogs kyis rdo rje dang*/ 'di de sangs rgyas sogs kyis dril bu dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar bo sogs kyis slob ma rdor sems su bsgom du 'jug pa phyag rgya'i dam tshig dang gsum sbyin no/ /de lta na/ sku phyag rgya'i dam tshig / gsung 'bras bu'i dam tshig /thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig dang gsum mo/ /'phrin las bzhi'i dbang ni/ rdo rje rgya gram sogs dang 'phrin las kyi gtso bo ni chos kyi 'khor lo yin pas/ thog mar 'khor lo/ dung*/ po ti/ dril bur bcas rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bya'o/ /chos bshad pa so so'i rjes gnang bdag po'i dbang ni/ rigs lnga'i bdag po sogs dang*/ gsang dbang ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya sogs kyis bskur ro/

/go rim de ltar byas pa ni shin tu 'brel chags mod/ der ma nges te bcu bo rnams kyi dbang ni ci dgar bskur zhes gsungs pas go rim ci rigs par byed rung ba'i phyir/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa slob dpon gyi dbang gi gtso bo yin kyang*/ bcu ba zhes pa'i dbang bcu'i grangs la mi the ste/ de las logs su de nas lag tu rdo rje dril bu sbyin zhes bkar ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid ni zhes sogs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dang*/ lha'i de nyid ni zhes sogs kyis dag pa dran tshul bstan la/ dran tshul ni/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi 'byung ba ni/ lha'i thugs sems can thams cad la mnyam par 'jug cing gnod sems sogs nye ring mtho dman du gyur pa'i mi mnyam pa med pa'i don mtshon/ de bzhin gzhan la'ang cho ga'i don ltar shes par bya'o/ /mdor na/ sangs rgyas kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de dang de rten dang brten pa de dang der shar ba yin gyi/ tha mal gyi snod bcud ltar don gzhan min snyam pa'i nges pa shugs can bya'o/ / gsum pa de dag gi mtha' brten la gsum/ rin chen bdun/ dam tshig dang*/ bka'i 'phrin las kyi dbang ngo*/ /dang po ni/ 'khor lo la sogs pa'i phyag rgya'am/ de dag gi gzugs thogs te/ oṃ tsakra rat+na zhes sogs kyi sngags rkyang ba'am/ rgyas par na/ gzhung ltar lha rdzas las byas sogs kyi tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas par rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya bar ṭika chen du bshad do/ /gnyis pa dam tshig dang bka'i dbang ni/ /dkon mchog gsum dang zhes pa nas/ snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos zhes pa'i bar gyis dam tshig dang*/ oṃ sarba sogs kyis bka'i dbang bskur ro/ / gsum pa 'phrin las kyi dbang ni/ oṃ sarba karmāḥsogs kyis byed par ṭīka chung du bshad kyang cho gar mi gsal lo/ /de nas bla ma la yon phul te/ bla mas kyang tshe 'di'i bde ba zhes sogs kyis gzengs bstod nas dam bzhag bya'o/

/bzhi ba gshin po rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga ji ltar bya ba ni/ spyir mang du yod kyang skabs 'dir bsdu na gsum/ sngon 'gro lho sgo'i cho ga /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ rjes su lam bstan sbyang sogs bya ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rnam shes bkug nas dgug dral byas te byin brlab bya ba/ bgegs dang dri ma sbyong ba/ skyabs 'gro bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni badz+ra dha ra sogs kyis nga rgyal bzung nas/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa ṭika chen nas bshad kyang*/ 'di ni dbang bskur ba'i tshe ma gtogs mi dgos pa 'dra'o/ /lho sgo ni gson po la'ang rung mod/ 'dir gshin po'i dbang du byas na/ lho sgo zhes pa lan don mi 'dra ba mang du 'dug kyang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgo'i phyogs su stegs bu gru bzhi ba byas te/ ba byung lnga dang*/ tsan dan sogs kyis byugs/ de'i steng du pad+ma dkar bo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bris pa'i steng du/ sngar khrus byas shing gnas rnams su gzhung 'ga' zhig nas 'byung ba ltar yi ge legs par btags pa'i ngo'am/ yang na de'i gos sam/ ming yig thig les brgyan pa gang rung bzhag ste sbyong bar ṭīka chen dang cho gar gsung la/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i kun rig cho ga'i zur 'debs las/ ming byang la sogs pa mdun du bzhag la zhes gsungs pas/ byung na snga ma ltar yin kyang*/ deng sang phyag len ni phyi ma dang mthun no/ /gang ltar yang rten de/ las bum mam/ bsang chu bsgrub pa sogs gang rung gis bsang sbyang bskyed pa gzhung ltar dang*/ 'dir ṭīka chen du rnam shes dgug gzhug gi rjes su dbang thob na lhar bskyed/ ces gsungs kyang*/ phyag len du ma byed par snang ngo*/ kha cig bum pa ma bsgrub par lho sgo byed pa'i lugs snang yang*/ ma tha'ang mgul 'ching sngon pos bkris pa'i bum pa'i nang du pad zla'i gdan la hūṃ yig gi mthar rtsa rig gam/

yig brgya sogs kyis bskor ba la dmigs te/ gzungs sngags de rnams bzlas nas khrus bum bsgrubs te/ lho sgo byed rung ba tsam yin kyang*/ dbang la ni/ de ltar mi rung zhing*/ khrus gsol tsam byas pa'i chu de yang nus can du khas len rung mod/ snga ma byas pa dang mi 'dra'o/ kha cig dgug sngags oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ dzaḥzhes pa'i dod la/ gsang 'dus lta bur oṃ badz+ra dhṛka zhes bsgyur ba ni don min te/ sngags de'i don rdo rje'i sems khug cig ces rnams shes 'gug sngags su spyir gsungs pas thams cad la sbyar rung bar ṭika chen du bshad pa'i phyir/ kha cig rnam shes 'gug mi nus/ khug na gson par 'gyur pas 'gug mi dgos so zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ de lta na lha bsgom pas kyang lhar dngos su mi 'gyur bas don med du thal ba dang*/ ling ka lta bu la dgug gzhug tshad ldan byas pa tsam gyis de gson por 'gyur ro/ kho na re/ lhar dngos su mi 'gyur yang de ltar mos pa'i rten 'brel gyi phan yon yod do zhe na/ cig shos la yang mtshungs te/ dngos su khugs rung ma khugs gang yin kyang chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel gyi phan yon yod la/ 'on kyang khugs ma khugs mi 'dra ba ni/ nus pa che chung gis phan yon kyang che chung du 'gyur bar sems so/ /dgug pa'i yul gyi ming mi shes shing gos sogs rten gzhan med na/ ṇi bris pa'i byang bu 'jog par kha cig bzhed la/ kha cig gson po la yang rnam shes dgug gzhug mdzad de brtag pa'i gnas so/ /gnas nyer gnyis byin gyis brlab pa yan chad byas rjes su/ /gshin por chos bshad bya bar ṭīka chung sogs 'ga' zhig nas bshad pas/ spros pa la dga' na bya'i gzhan du ma byas kyang rung ngo*/ /gnyis pa sbyang ba la gsum/ bgegs sbyang ba/ sdig pa sbyang ba/ mi shis pa sbyang pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal du bskyed de khro bo spyan drangs/

khro bo rnams dang lhan cig bgegs la bka' bsgos nas/ zhi ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ drag pos sbyong ba rnams bya ste/ de yang gtor ma gsum bsngo ba ni zhi ba dang*/ ting lo phyir bskor ba ni zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ hūṃ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis bden stobs dang sum bha ni brjod de nyungs kar gyis brab pa ni drag pos sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gsum zhi ba/ gnyis pa rdzas zhi ba sngags drag po ting 'dzin zhi drag phyed ma/ gsum pa ni gsum ka'ang drug po'o/ /bgegs gang sbyong na/ tshe 'das mtho ris dang thar bar bgrod pa'i bgegs thams cad dang*/ khyad par tshe 'das kyi tshe sngon ma dang 'dra ba'i cha byad bzung nas de'i nye 'brel sogs kyi rmi lam dang de dag gi mthong snang du byung nas gnod par byed pa'i 'byung po mang du yod pa de dag sbyong ngo*/ /deng sang 'jig rten pa mang bos/ rang gi rmi lam dang*/ mthong snang dang*/ thos pa'i rkyen 'ga' zhig la brten nas/ tshe 'das grir shi ba lta bu lo mang du song yang skye ba ma blangs par bgegs sogs kyis bzungs nas yod pa dang*/ tshe snga ma'i dbyibs dang gos gyon pa rnams dngos yin par 'dzin pa ni blun pa'i rtags yin te/ de ltar rmi lam du byung ba ni 'khrul pa'i bag chags dang mthong snang 'byung yang*/ tshe 'das min zhing bgegs sogs kyi cho 'phrul yin par ston pa rang nyid kyis mdo sogs las gsungs shing*/ ṭīka chen du'ang mthun par bshad pa dang*/ gal te tshe 'das yin na de'i phung bo dang gos sogs thams cad mes bsreg pa dang med par byas zin nas slar ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur bsam dgos so/ /gnyis pa sdig pa sbyang ba la gsum/ sbyin sreg dang brab sngags la/ khrus kyi sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ phyag len du raṃ las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba bskyed pa'i dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro skad cig gis bskyed nas gnas gsum du yi ge bkod de ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod byed kyang cho gar skad cig gis bskyed nas gzhan mi bya bar tshe 'das kyi rkang mthil sogs su rlung dkyil sogs bskyed/

de bzhin du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zur 'debs sogs gzhan mang bo las kyang gsung*/ ṭīka chen ltar na/ dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod de ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su baṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gyis mtshan pa las rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskyed pa'i cho ga gsum bskyed byas nas gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes pa sbyan drangs pa sogs bya dgos so/ /tshe 'das kyis snying khar yi ge baṃ nag po bsam la sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus par dmigs te/ rkang mthil gyi rlung g.yos lte ba'i me 'bar ba'i 'od kyis/ snying kha'i baṃ de nyid yar ded nas steng gi sna sgo nas 'thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs kyi rnam pa can du gyur nas rang gi lag par bzung ba'i til sogs la thim par bsam/ til ni sdig pa 'dags byed kyi rdzas khyad par can yin pas de dgos kyang med na gzhan gyis dod bya la/ kha cig sngar gzungs sngags sogs btab pa'i yungs kar sogs de'i tshab tu byed pa ni/ de'i tshe sdig pa dang til ngo bo dbyer med du byas nas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du btab pas zhes pa na sdig pa zad par mos dgos par gsungs pas/ sngags btab pa'i yungs kar sogs sdig pa sbyong byed kho na yin pas/ sdig par mos pa ni cung zad mi 'tsham mo/ /badz+ra ḍa ki sogs kyis sbyin sreg brgya stong sogs byas nas gshegs/ gnyis pa brab sngags kyis sbyang ba ni/ sa'am/ thal ba yungs kar phye ma sogs dang ṭika chen ltar na chu yang rung la/ lha'i sngags rnams dang*/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ dri med/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa/ kaṃ ka ni sogs/ bzlas nas rten la brab par bya'o/ /rtsa rig dang lha rnams kyi sngags kyis mjug tu spel tshig byed par yang gsung la/ brab sngags ni/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ zhes sogs gzhung ltar lha/ de ni phyir zlog gi spyaud tshul gtso bo yin no/ /gsum pa khrus kyis sbyang ba ni/

khrus bum logs su yod dam med kyang rnam rgyal bum pas dkyil 'khor la khrus byas rjes/ ro'am/ ming byang sogs bkru bar bya ste/ de yang 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu zhes sogs phyin drug so so la sbyar nas rtsa rig spel tshig dang bcas pas khrus bya'o/ /de bzhin du chu bo drug zhes sogs dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs dang*/ sa ni dug gi sogs gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa brjod do/ / gsum pa ni/ gang la ser sna sogs yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis brjod de sbyong*/ gtsug dgu dang*/ ṭīka chen ltar na bkra shis brjod pa'i tshe khrus byas kyang rung*/ gsum pa skyabs 'gro bstan pa ni/ bla dang sangs rgyas lha'i dkyil 'khor sogs phyag 'tshal ci rigs par byas pa'i mjug tu khyad par nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la skyabs su 'gro zhing phyag ni/ spyod 'jug gi gtso bo rgyal ba sogs kyis byed do/ /de ltar lho sgo'i cho ga ni/ gson dbang gi skabs su slob ma sta gon byed pa'i dod du gsungs pas dbang bskur ba la sogs la tshad ldan byung na gshin po la dbang bskur bar byas na shin tu phan yon che bar spyod rgyud sogs las gsungs kyang*/ gang byung gi dbang byed pa las ni/ spyod pa tsam byas pa legs so/ / gnyis pa ni/ gal te dbang bskur ba'i brtan pa thob pa dang*/ dbang med kyis dbang bskur byed na/ tshe 'das dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i mdun du 'dug par mos nas/ dmigs bsal 'ga' zhig ma gtogs slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ /de'i tshe dbang don brda 'phrod pa gal che zhing*/ lung sogs kyis spros pa ma byas kyang rung bar gsung*/ mthar tshe 'das cho ga gsum bskyed kyi rdor sems su bskyed pa'am/ yang na pho yin na rnam snang*/ mo yin spyan mar bskyed de/ ye shes pa gzhug kyang rung la/ yang na ye shes pa gdod nas grub par bsams te/

chu gnyis nyer spyaud rol ma dang bcas mchod nas bstod/ ṭīka chen sogs nas zas gtad byed mi dgos par gsungs/ gal te byed na gzhung ltar bya'o/ /de mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yar sngar bshad pa ltar tshe 'das slar ma shi ba'i skabs bzhin du snang ba yod pa ni/ 'byung bo wa ra hin ta sogs kyi sprul bas bslu bar ston pa yin la/ tshe 'das dngos min pas tshe 'das de la zas mer sreg pa tsam mi phan yang*/ zas nor gyis gzhan la mchod pa dang btang ba'i dge ba phan par gsung ngo*/ /'on kyang bar do'i sems can la dri bsur sogs sbyin par bshad pa'i gzhung yang snang bas zad gtad byas kyang nyes par mi 'gyur ba 'dra'o/ kha cig phung ba'i mdun du zas sna mang bo dang mchod pa'i rnam grangs byed pa ni/ gang zag de khyad par can yin na ma gtogs/ mu stegs sogs 'ga' zhig gi lugs dang mtshungs so/ /de yang bar do'i sems can gyi tshe tshad ni zhag bdun yin pas/ de nas shi ste skye ba len dgos la/ gal te skye ba len pa'i tshe/ 'gro ba gzhan du mi skye bar slar yang bar dor skyes kyang*/ bdun phrag bdun tshun chad du bar dor skye ba mod la/ de phan chad du bar dor skye ba dor nas nges par 'gro ba gzhan du skye ba'i nyid mtshams sbyar ba mkhas grub tshad ldan gyi gzhung mang bo las 'byung ba/ kha cig bar do ba 'ga' zhig lor song yang yod de mthong snang du byung zer ba dang*/ sngo gyi gnas der gang 'dod du 'ongs nas zas sogs la longs spyod pa yod de/ rmi lam du byung zer ba ni sngar bgag zin cing mkhas pa'i bzhed pa yang min la/ 'on kyang cho ga ni/ skye ba gzhan du blangs zin pa'i rjes su byas kyang phan yon yod par gsung ngo*/ / gsum pa lam bstan sogs ni/ dkon mchog rin chen sogs kyis lam bstan/ pad ma 'dam gyis zhes sogs kyis lam sbyangs/ sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i zhes sogs kyis tshe 'das bde ba can du skyes pa des cho ga byas pa'i mthu yin par shes nas ched brjod dang*/

e ma'o shākya zhes sogs kyis cho ga byed pa'i drung du 'ongs nas ched brjod byas na/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe ṭa zhes sogs kyis slar yang bde ba can du song bar bsam/ mthar phung bo dang byang bu gson dgongs ma brjod de bsreg go kho na re/ sems can de'i rnam shes bde ba can sogs la song zin nas/ phung po byang bu la yid dang rna ba'i rnam shes med pas/ gson cig dgongs shig ces brjod mi rigs so zer na/ skyon med de/ sngags kyi skabs su dngos po'i gnas tshod dang blo'i mos pa gnyis 'dra mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na/ rang nyid lha min kyang lhar bsgom du rung ba bzhin no/ /de yang log par mi 'gyur te/ de ni mi shes pa'i 'khrul ba gzhan dang mi 'dra bar mos pa'i mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dran pa'i rten 'brel bsgom pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / bzhi ba mjug gi rim pa ni/ btang rag gi mchod bstod bsngo smon/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang*/ bzod gsol byas nas/ rdul tshon yin na/ lha rang rang gi dam rgya bcings la sarba bid sogs rang rang gi snying bo lan gsum gsum brjod de dam rgya bkrol nas gshegs/ ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs bya'o/ /rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ byang gi sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ sems dpa' gtsug tor gyi phyag rgyas srung*/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing me tog gi char bab par bya'o/ /sngags kyi don dang phyag rgya logs su 'god 'dod pas 'dir ma bris so/ / smras pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi bstan pa'i snying bo mchog /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa rnam gnyis las/ /ches zab gsang sngags 'bras bu'i theg pa ste/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bla med bzhi/ /'dir ni dpal ldan rnal 'byor rgyud kun gyi/ /gtso bor gyur pa ngan song spyong ba'i rgyud/ /de yi dgongs 'grel dkyil 'khor cho ga'i gtso/

/rgyud don gsal ba rang 'grel bcas pa yin/ /gang 'di'i tshig don mdzes byang lhan thabs kyi/ snying bo don ldan chu skyes gzhon nu 'di/ /rnam dpyod sor mo'i skyed tshul las bskrun te/ gzur gnas blo ldan 'ga' yi rgyan du byas/ kho bo sbyangs ba chung zhing brtson pa lhod/ dri med rigs pa'i mig dang mi ldan yang*/ /rab dkar lhag bsam dag pa'i stobs shugs kyis/ /'di ltar bgyis la nyes par mi 'gyur snyam/ deng dus rgyal ba'i dbang bo dngos byon yang*/ /phan par mi nus gnas skabs 'dir gyur tshe/ /shin tu nyam chung byis pa bdag lta bus/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pas su zhig mgu bar nus/ de phyir blo gros lang tsho rab rgyas shing*/ /legs bshad don gnyer phyogs lhung bral ba 'ga'/ ma gtogs phrag dog tsher mas yid kyi khams/ dkrugs pa'i mkhas rlom gzhan la phan par dka'/ /'gro ba kun gyi mig gcig pad+mo'i gnyen/ /mngon dang lkog tu gyur ba'i khyad par gyis/ /rang gi 'dod pa ji bzhin ma gyur tshe/ /smod na gzhan la lta yang ci zhig smaus/ /gzhung don mkhas pa'i legs bshad dang mthun zhing*/ rang bzor zhugs pa'i nyes pas ma gos kyang*/ ma rtogs log rtog nor ba'i cha srid na/ /tshad ldan mkhas pa dbang du byas te bshags/ /dge legs cha shas rgyas pa'i 'od dkar can/ /rmongs pa'i mun stugs dgra las rnam rgyal nas/ blo gsal kun+da bzhad dang lhan cig tu/ /thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan du 'gyur phyir bsngo/ /ces blo bzang rgyal ba'i thugs sras 'dul 'dzin pa'i rgyud don gsal ba 'grel ba dang bcas pa'i tshigs don gyi lhan thab mdor bsdus yang gsal sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang blo bzang sbyin pa dang slob dpon blo gros rgya mtsho zhal snga nas rnam pa gnyis kyis zhabs rdul la reg pa gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra bar btags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas tse ne dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du mtshan nyid gsang 'dzugs kyi bla ma'i go sar gnas pa de'i tshe/
